text: QD-6: MitosisEngine calibration — split_threshold=0.3 but measured tension maxes at 0.037 (8x short) while below merge_threshold=0.05 on 100% of steps, so the engine can only merge and mitosis never fires (cell count pinned at min_cells=2 under fixed / noise / rotating input alike). Fix the calibration, then re-run QD-5's population test. Also open: MitosisC.__init__ force-grows by cloning cells[0], which the merge logic then deletes.
